_source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 — Annex IX (risk zones), Annex X (zone risk weights), Annex XXIII (earthquake zone correlation). OJ L 12, 17.1.2015. Annex XXII (windstorm), XXIV (flood), XXV (hail) zone correlation.
_citation: Del. Reg. (EU) 2015/35, Art. 122 + Annexes IX, X, XXIII
_note: Country-agnostic exact-zonal tables. Each region under a peril carries its Annex IX zones (name + Annex X risk weight W) and the Annex XXII-XXVI zone-correlation matrix, keyed by zone id (dict-of-dicts — zone ids need not be contiguous). Loaded (all extracted from the OJ PDF, validated: complete weights, symmetric, unit diagonal, weight-zone set == matrix-zone set): Croatia earthquake (21 admin-unit zones) and Germany windstorm/earthquake/flood/hail (95 zones each, keyed by 2-digit postcode; the four non-existent German postcodes 05/11/43/62 are absent). All extracted from the OJ PDF and validated: complete weights, symmetric matrices, unit diagonal, weight-zone set == matrix-zone set.
